scripts.build: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix app/cloudflare-worker run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p app/cloudflare-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm --prefix app run test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && vitest run app/cloudflare-worker/src
scripts.validate:code: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:coverage && npm run validate:website && npm run validate:www && npm run validate:mcp && npm run validate:mcp-host && npm run validate:cloudflare-build
scripts.validate:cloudflare: npm run build && cd app/cloudflare-worker && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.panel.jsonc
scripts.validate:cloudflare-build: npm --prefix app/cloudflare-worker run build && npm --prefix app/cloudflare-worker run test
scripts.validate:mcp: npm --prefix app/mcp-worker run typecheck && npm --prefix app/mcp-worker run test
scripts.validate:mcp-host: npm --prefix mcp/product-host ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix mcp/product-host run check
scripts.validate:worker: npm run validate:code && npm run validate:cloudflare
